title: Reverse Array
question: Reverse array in-place.

solution.code:
def reverseArray(arr):
    left, right = 0, len(arr) - 1
    while left < right:
        arr[left], arr[right] = arr[right], arr[left]
        left += 1
        right -= 1
    return arr

explanation: Solve reverse array using an efficient approach.

title: Maximum Product
question: Max product subarray.

solution.code:
def maxProduct(nums):
    res = cur_max = cur_min = nums[0]
    for x in nums[1:]:
        candidates = (x, cur_max * x, cur_min * x)
        cur_max = max(candidates)
        cur_min = min(candidates)
        res = max(res, cur_max)
    return res

explanation: Solve maximum product using an efficient approach.
